stemMd: What was unusual about the first month?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It had the heaviest storm on record.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The pupils measured every storm before making a claim.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It was dry and had no intense storm.

explanationMd: The rainfall comparison showed unusually dry conditions and no intense storm. That limited the strength of the pupils’ first conclusion. Successful operation in mild conditions does not test performance under a severe challenge.

distractorRationale.a: The passage says no intense storm occurred.
distractorRationale.e: The roof remains the source of collected water.
distractorRationale.b: Their first claim preceded the later measurement programme.
distractorRationale.c: Almost no water reached the overflow drain.
